title.en: Quoting Paul Ford

summary.en: For a while, I must admit, it looked as if software developer roles like mine were done for. How could we fight against tireless robots? But our industry is slowly realizing that making truly cutting-edge software still requires humans to think and work together, to maximize their skill sets and to practice their respective crafts. title.en: Quoting Boris Cherny

summary.zh: 由 Claude 编写的生产代码应该比由人类编写的代码具有更高的标准。在Anthropic，我们有许多防护措施来确保这种情况发生：大量的 lint 规则、大量的测试、Claude 驱动的端到端测试、Claude 驱动的模糊器每天运行、自动代码审查和安全审查、自动代码重构等等。如果没有这些，您最终可能会陷入混乱，难以维护。 — 鲍里斯
summary.en: Production code written by Claude should have a higher bar than if it was written by a human. At Anthropic, we have many guardrails in place to make sure this is happening: lots of lint rules, lots of tests, Claude-driven end to end tests, Claude-powered fuzzers running daily, automated code reviews and security reviews, automated code refactoring, and so on. Without these, you can end up with a mess that is hard to maintain down the line. — Boris Cherny Tags: claude , ai , claude-code , l

title.en: Vercel Sandbox now provides 64 GB of storage

summary.zh: 每个 Vercel 沙箱现在包含 64 GB 的存储空间，从 32 GB 增加。这包括从 Vercel 托管映像或自定义映像创建的沙箱，以及使用已弃用的运行时属性配置的沙箱。额外的空间为大型存储库、依赖项、构建工件、溢出到磁盘的数据工作负载以及存储密集型代理任务提供了更多空间。在文档中了解有关沙盒图像的更多信息。阅读更多
summary.en: Every Vercel Sandbox now includes 64 GB of storage, up from 32 GB. This includes sandboxes created from a Vercel Managed Image or custom image, as well as those configured with the deprecated runtime property. The additional space provides more room for large repositories, dependencies, build artifacts, data workloads that spill to disk, and storage-intensive agent tasks. Learn more about Sandbox images in the documentation. Read more

title.en: Control who can manage connectors in Vercel Connect

summary.zh: 专业版和企业版团队现在可以控制谁可以创建和管理 Vercel Connect 连接器。连接器允许应用程序和代理使用您的团队管理的凭据访问外部服务。所有者可以在“团队设置”中的“连接器权限”下启用此限制。启用后，只有具有所有者角色或连接器管理员扩展权限的人员才能创建或管理连接器。浏览所有连接器，或在Vercel了解更多信息
summary.en: Pro and Enterprise teams can now control who can create and manage Vercel Connect connectors. Connectors let applications and agents access external services using credentials managed by your team. Owners can enable this restriction under Connector Permissions in Team Settings . Once enabled, only people with the Owner role or Connector Manager extended permission can create or manage connectors. Browse all connectors , or learn more in the Vercel Connect documentation . Read more

title.zh: 任何 Nix 软件包都存在于您的浏览器中
title.en: Any Nix package, live in your browser

summary.zh: 任何 Nix 软件包，都存在于您的浏览器中，Farid Zakaria 称其为“Nix 工作的巨著”，我明白为什么。 trynix.dev 提供了一个由 qemu-wasm 支持的 x86_64 Linux 虚拟机，通过 WebAssembly 完全在浏览器中运行。然后可以使用过去 13 年中的任何 Nix 软件包来启动该虚拟机。它们是 URL 可寻址的，因此您可以导航到此页面：https://trynix.dev/?pkg=python3%403.6.2 然后单击“加载”并获取交互式 shell
summary.en: Any Nix package, live in your browser Farid Zakaria calls this his " magnum opus of Nix work", and I can see why. trynix.dev provides a qemu-wasm powered x86_64 Linux virtual machine running entirely in your browser through WebAssembly. That VM can then be booted with any Nix package from the past 13 years. They are URL addressable, so you can navigate to this page: https://trynix.dev/?pkg=python3%403.6.2 Then click "Load" and get an interactive shell against a virtual machine running Python 3.6

items.summary_zh: 现在，您可以使用 Vercel 上的 OpenAI 代理 API 构建和部署长期运行、使用工具的代理。 OpenAI 管理代理循环和会话状态，而 Vercel 托管应用程序并将每个会话连接到 Vercel 沙箱以执行代码和文件访问。通过此集成，您可以获得： OpenAI 管理的代理循环和会话状态 通过签名的 OpenAI webhooks 和 Vercel 队列创建可靠的沙箱并重新连接 隔离的执行

summary.en: You and your agents can now read and search the Vercel changelog feed from your terminal using vercel changelog . Coding agents can use this command to discover new Vercel products and features, find updates relevant to your project, and read full announcements to inform their recommendations. vercel changelog returns the latest five changelogs with full Markdown content. You can also set the number of results, search all changelogs using a keyword, and access JSON output for scripts and agents.
